title: Solara -- SetHomes
description: Solara — SetHomes is the first official plugin from Solara Development, designed to provide a clean, efficient, and fully customizable home management system for Minecraft servers.
body:
# 🌅 **Solara — SetHomes**

> **Set. Manage. Teleport.**

---

## ✦ Overview

**Solara — SetHomes** is a **modern, high-performance home management plugin** built for servers that value speed, structure, and smooth UX.
It focuses on **efficient storage, minimal overhead, and intuitive interaction**—so everything works fast and reliably.

---

## 🏠 Features

➤ **Multi-home support**
Create, edit, delete, and teleport to homes easily.

➤ **GUI with pagination**
Clean interface with next/previous navigation (fully configurable).

➤ **Command + GUI system**
Use `/sethome`, `/home`, or the GUI.

➤ **Permission-based limits**
Control how many homes players can have.

---

## 💾 Storage

➤ **Lightweight system**
Optimized to reduce lag and memory usage.

➤ **Flexible formats**

* YAML / JSON (default)
* MySQL *(coming soon)*

➤ **Auto-save protection**
Prevents data loss during crashes or restarts.

➤ **Fast data access**
Efficient read/write operations.

---

## ⚙️ Performance

✔ Low CPU usage
✔ Stable TPS
✔ Optimized backend
✔ No unnecessary load

---

## 🎨 Customization

➤ Editable configs
➤ Custom messages & sounds
➤ GUI layout control
➤ Page limits
➤ Teleport settings

---

## 🚀 Why Solara

Fast. Clean. Reliable.
Built for modern Minecraft servers.

---

## 💡 Ecosystem

Part of **Solara Development** — focused on optimized, scalable solutions.

---

Solara — SetHomes
*Power. Performance. Simplicity.*
